messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0b 00} do you 
have any dreams for the 
future, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Me? {01 00 00 05 00}Getting married and
having a happy life would
be OK, I guess{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}But my real dream is to
make this fossil collection 
into something great.
{07 0d 00}You know, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}, 
build the grand and mighty 
{04 01 00} Fossil Memorial!
{07 06 00}If you're up to it,{01 00 00 05 00} grab a
shovel and start diggin',
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0b 00} kas sul
on tuleviku kohta
unistusi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Minul? {01 00 00 05 00}Abielluda ja
elada õnnelikku elu
oleks vist OK{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Aga mu tõeline unistus on
teha sellest fossiilikogust
midagi suurt.
{07 0d 00}Tead, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00},
ehitada suur ja vägev
{04 01 00} fossiilimemoriaal!
{07 06 00}Kui sa oled valmis,{01 00 00 05 00} haara
labidas ja hakka kaevama,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So I understand that{01 00 00 05 00}
people only want the latest
and greatest gadgets{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}But don't they understand
that all that stuff is
obsolete the next year?
{07 13 00}Truly great stuff stands 
the test of time.{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}Like fossils, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Meh!{01 00 00 05 00} You'll understand
when you're older!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii et ma saan aru, et{01 00 00 05 00}
inimesed tahavad ainult
uusimaid vidinaid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 15 00}Aga kas nad ei mõista,
et kogu see kraam on
järgmisel aastal vananenud?
{07 13 00}Tõeliselt suur kraam peab
ajaproovile vastu.{01 01 00}
{07 19 00}Nagu fossiilid, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Ptüi!{01 00 00 05 00} Sa mõistad,
kui vanemaks saad!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}There is no rational 
reason behind why people
act the way they do.
There's just no explaining{07 0b 00}
why someone is drawn to
something, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}And it's not just because 
something is popular or 
cute. It's something else.
{07 00 00}I mean, the reason I'm so 
into fossil hunting right 
now is that they are old.
{07 19 00}And they're all dry and
cracked. That's interesting,
right, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Pole ratsionaalset
põhjust, miks inimesed
käituvad just nii.
Lihtsalt ei saa seletada,{07 0b 00}
miks kedagi millegi poole
tõmbab, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Ja see pole lihtsalt
sellepärast, et miski on
popp või armas. Miski muu.
{07 00 00}Põhjus, miks ma praegu
fossiilijahi lainel olen,
on see, et nad on vanad.
{07 19 00}Ja nad on kuivad ja
pragulised. See on huvitav,
eks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
